packages.costs: Private service is US$450 per adult, or US$1,800 calculated for four. Shared-group service was also displayed at US$360 per adult, or US$1,440 calculated for four. The fare includes the hotel, guide, Sacred Valley and Machu Picchu entry, return rail and site bus, ground transfers, and one each of breakfast, lunch and dinner. Allow extra for airfare, Cusco hotel nights, tips, insurance and the optional Huayna Picchu climb. The operator lists a 6% fee on online card or PayPal balance payments.
packages.terms: The itinerary asks for the balance by 6:30 p.m. two days before departure and a briefing the evening before. The general policy gives a later deadline for some payment methods, so verify the applicable date. Cancellations up to 24 hours in advance receive unused costs back after deductions for purchased, nonrefundable train or entry tickets and services. The overview names Vistadome, and the day-by-day itinerary names Expedition, so the rail class needs confirmation.
packages.operatorReview: The operator publishes 35 reviews for this tour, including praise for the guides’ explanations and train logistics. An independent July 2026 Tripadvisor review of another Peru Hike tour described prompt communication and organized transport.
packages.accommodationReview: The itinerary identifies the overnight property only as a hotel in Aguas Calientes. The published reviews do not identify the booked property or room category.
packages.operatorReviewShort: Guides praised in the tour’s 35 operator-hosted reviews

holding.name: Lares trek and Hiram Bingham train · June 4–11
holding.reason: Beyond Adventures lists places for June 4–11, 2027. After three days in Cusco the group treks the Lares route, visits Machu Picchu and returns by luxury train. A past day-by-day itinerary uses camps. The current year’s flyer names the Cusco hotel but leaves the two trekking nights unspecified. The website quotes USD 6,795 per person (early fare USD 6,545), while its older flyer quotes less and names June 13–20, a date the current booking list omits.
holding.next: Verify the two trail nights, two private sleeping units, current price, start airport and any June 13 departure. The online enquiry gives no room inventory.

holding.name: Sacred Valley & Machu Picchu Walk · May 10 and June 7
holding.reason: World Expeditions lists May 10–19 and June 7–16, 2027 for its ten-day hotel-based walk. Its public calendar exposed start and end dates without a departure-specific room count or a successful two-room quote.
holding.next: Open the booking calendar for these two starts. Confirm live places, fare, accommodation and the KM 104 day-walk permit.

holding.name: G Adventures · Lima, The Sacred Valley & Machu Picchu by Train
holding.reason: April 22–May 2: dated operator checkout reported just two seats despite an older brochure showing 7+ and a distributor reporting three. May 20–30: the distributor marked it sold out and the operator calendar showed no fare.
holding.next: Recheck both operator departure dates for four seats and two rooms.

holding.name: On The Go Tours · Lima to Cusco
holding.reason: Seven-day partially guided trip by rail with Sacred Valley sightseeing. The provider displayed 2027 month options, but the initial calendar was outside the requested window.
holding.next: Select April, May and June 2027 and test four adults in two standard rooms. Verify pricing for the Lima–Cusco flight.

holding.name: Exodus — The Inca Trail
holding.reason: Three of seven nights are in full-service trail camps and four are in hotels. The US calendar showed Apr 25–May 2 at US$2,343 per person and Jun 6–13 at US$2,419, both guaranteed and available. May 9–16 was available at US$2,520 before reaching minimum numbers. May 2 was sold out and May 16 had two places. Fares exclude flights. This itinerary cannot provide bedrooms every night.
holding.next: Revisit if two tents on the trail are acceptable. Verify four permits, two tents together and two hotel rooms.

holding.name: Backroads — Peru Hiking & Walking Tour
holding.reason: The seven-day Sacred Valley and short Inca Trail calendar showed request-only for Apr 30–May 6 and one place for Jun 13–19. Other listed starts in the travel window were sold out. Earlier indexed versions showed more availability.
holding.next: Recheck the official calendar for four guests and two rooms, particularly Apr 30.

holding.name: Terra Quechua Peru — Short Inca Trail to Machu Picchu
holding.reason: Two days from Cusco, with the KM104 hike, Wiñay Wayna, the Sun Gate, two citadel entries and one night in an unnamed three-star hotel in Aguas Calientes. In 2027 group service is US$560 per adult, or US$600 per person for a private party of four (US$2,400). The permit calendar did not return dated room stock.
holding.next: Check a specific start for four short-trail permits and two exclusive double rooms. The last downhill bus and several meals are extra.

holding.name: Trafalgar — Peru With Machu Picchu
holding.reason: Fares were displayed for April 17, May 1 and June 12, with no visible room stock. May 15 was explicitly sold out even though labeled a definite departure.
holding.next: Check April 17, May 1 and June 12 for four travelers in two rooms. Revisit May 15 if its sold-out notice changes.

holding.name: Odysseys Unlimited — Treasures of Peru
holding.status: Agency seat counts; operator confirmation pending
holding.reason: Pavlus reports six seats for each of April 19 and May 24, and three for May 3. The operator’s own request requires later confirmation. A total including airfare and taxes for four in two rooms was not established.
holding.next: Recheck April 19 and May 24 for the airport-specific fare, tax and two double rooms. May 3 requires an additional seat.

holding.name: FLY CUSCO Perú · two-day Sacred Valley and Machu Picchu by train
holding.reason: Date-filtered Viator searches on April 17 and June 12 returned this small-group overnight rail tour. A third-party guide reports a US$429 per-person price check on April 17. The tour adds PEN 90 per person for Sacred Valley entry and has nonrefundable terms. Neither listing proves space for four in two rooms.
holding.next: Check four adults in the live date selector for April 17–18 or June 12–13, including hotel tier, price and simultaneous two-room allocation.

holding.name: Kondor Path Tours · private two-day Sacred Valley and Machu Picchu
holding.reason: The operator quotes US$446 per person for four (US$1,784 before lodging) in its 2027 table for the private Pisac, Ollantaytambo and Machu Picchu tour. The preferred-date enquiry gives no stock, and travelers arrange their own Aguas Calientes hotel.
holding.next: Recheck for dated train seats and site admission, then price two rooms for the same night.

holding.name: Intrepid · Machu Picchu by Train Independent Short Break
holding.reason: The three-day independent trip runs from Cusco via the Sacred Valley and Aguas Calientes. A reseller lists April 21–23 and May 10–12 at US$1,305 per person. No dated room allocation was visible.
holding.next: Test both dates on the operator’s booking page for four adults in two rooms and compare the live fare.
